newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey welcomes EU initiative in Greece disputes.
newsitem.headline: Turkey welcomes EU initiative in Greece disputes.

text.p: Turkey said on Wednesday it would be willing in principle to accept EU-inspired outside mediation in its many disputes with neighbour Greece.
"We would be happy to do so if making use of methods like help from third parties were helpful for dialogue," foreign ministry spokesman Omer Akbel told a news conference.
He was referring to proposals by European Union diplomats for each side to nominate independent mediators, known as "Wise Men", to negotiate their differences.
Dutch Foreign Minister Hans Van Mierlo, whose country holds the EU's current presidency, was expected to discuss the initiative on a visit to Ankara beginning on Thursday.
NATO members Turkey and Greece are at odds over the divided island of Cyprus, territory in the Aegean Sea and minority rights.
Athens has blocked many of Turkey's attempts to get closer to the EU and has prevented funds from Brussels from reaching Ankara.
